access_token.description: Secret delegated user bearer for this consumer. Service bearer stays in Authorization.
access_token.title: Access Token

BackendServiceBearer.description: Backend-to-Portal service credential. Never the delegated user token or primary Portal bearer.

PortalUserBearer.description: Primary Portal session bearer. Never forwarded to a product backend.

post.description: Requires PortalUserBearer. A hash-only, single-use code expires within 60 seconds and remains bound to the parent session and configured consumer. The registered callback is deployment-owned; callback/redirect body fields are refused. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. 401: invalid parent session; 403: unknown consumer; 422: invalid PKCE/body; 503: policy/storage unavailable.
post.summary: Issue a consumer-bound S256 authorization code

get.description: Read actual usage for server-selected current or eligible historical allowances. Requires an active verified-email Portal session. No caller-selected owner or allowance IDs. No-store responses; backend outages and concurrent paid-state changes return retryable 503.

Requires BackendServiceBearer with access-snapshot:read. The credential selects consumer, products and current policy P; tenant_id/region can only narrow its scope. R is the whole-user paid revision. Included allowances must retain this consumer's technical source and backend ownership; policy changes cannot transfer existing allowances or usage. Only included products and their supporting facts bound completeness and expiry. Read-only local GET: no backend/LBX calls or usage writes. Known empty users return R0. All responses are no-store; browser Origin is refused. 401: service credential; 403: scope/permission/browser; 404: unknown scoped user; 422: malformed or missing scope; 503: retained allowance owner conflict, overdue included facts, stale policy, storage/capacity/clock unavailable. Quantity is the purchased ceiling. Backends must bind consumer/scope/P/R, preserve durable floors, and atomically reserve/finalize/release in their own usage storage; this read alone cannot admit execution.
get.summary: Read this consumer's committed paid authority (V3)

post.description: Requires BackendServiceBearer with allowance-exhaustion:write. Validates the sender's product and retained source/backend ownership plus the full issued tuple. 204 follows durable commit, including duplicates and historical cycles. All responses are no-store; browser Origin is refused. The hint can schedule GET-only reconciliation; it never revokes, refills or sends financial commands.
post.summary: Durably accept one immutable allowance exhaustion hint (V1)

post.description: Requires BackendServiceBearer with backend-session:exchange. Consumer identity comes from the service credential; the body contains only the code and S256 verifier. Returns a V2 delegated user bearer, canonical UUID/scope, consumer and current policy revision. Lifetime is at most 30 minutes and parent expiry. No refresh token. All responses are no-store. 401: invalid/used/expired/foreign code or parent; 403: scope/permission; 422: invalid body; 503: policy/storage unavailable. Origin-bearing browser requests are refused.

Requires BackendServiceBearer with backend-session:introspect in Authorization. The secret access_token body field contains the delegated USER bearer, not the service credential. Validates consumer audience, active user, parent revocation/expiry and current policy. Read-only; no refresh or PII. valid_until includes the configured conservative clock budget. All responses are no-store. 401: backend_delegation_expired or backend_parent_authority_invalid; 403: scope/permission/browser; 422: invalid secret body; 503: policy/storage unavailable.
post.summary: Validate this backend's delegated user on every protected request
